description: Saudi onshore entity of global asset manager Franklin Templeton, launched March 2024 with a new Riyadh office (Northern Ring Rd, Hittin district). A single-shareholder closed joint stock company (unified registration 7036955537, paid-up capital SAR 30m), licensed by the CMA (licence no. 23265-22) for 'Managing Investments and Operating Funds' and 'Advising' activities in securities.

Total held to 40 (well below the naive 60 fit-only figure) because this is almost certainly the weakest access/timing case in the batch: a global top-tier asset manager standing up a local CMI very likely runs on a global group-wide investment/fund platform it is not about to replace for one onshore entity, and OFS's Riyadh-office/local-content story is more relevant to the licensing/procurement side than to a systems sale here. Recorded as nurture, not skipped, because a genuinely local systems need (e.g. Saudi-specific regulatory reporting the global platform does not cover) is plausible and worth a specific-angle check, not a blanket dismissal.
